jobs.title: Emergency Physician- Shelburne
jobs.full_description_text: Company Description Nova Scotia Health is the largest provider of health services in Nova Scotia, with some specialized services also offered to clients throughout Atlantic Canada. We’re on a mission to achieve excellence in health, healing, and learning through working together, which is reflected in the hospitals, health centers, and community-based programs we operate across the province. Our passionate team of professionals provides a variety of high-quality inpatient and outpatient services including academic, tertiary, and quaternary care, as well as continuing care, primary health care, public health, and mental health and addictions. Join a diverse team of innovators, collaborators, and creative thinkers today. Roseway Hospital (RH) is seeking a full-time emergency physician who, if desired, can also provide office based comprehensive primary care and inpatient care. RH provides health care services to approximately 15,000 Shelburne County residents including inpatient, outpatient, and satellite care as well as primary, ambulatory, and emergency care. Located in Shelburne, RH has 19 inpatient beds and works closely with other health care facilities in Yarmouth, Kentville, Liverpool, Bridgewater, and Halifax. Shelburne County also has a collaborative practice clinic that provides the opportunity to mentor medical residents enrolled in the Dalhousie Family Medicine Program. Job Description Responsibilities full scope of practice as an emergency physician providing care to patients within the zone responsible to the Zone Department Head for Emergency Medicine for their professional responsibilities and quality of practice and will operate within the Medical Staff Bylaws of the Nova Scotia Health Authority. Expected Hours Multiple opportunities exist. full-time part-time locum Remuneration $223.90 Daytime $233.87 Nighttime Incentives Nova Scotia Health offers a variety of incentives designed to relieve some of the pressure, cost, and difficulty that comes with relocation. View Incentive Details Here Benefits Successful candidates may be eligible for our benefits package including health and dental, EMR grants, funded locum coverage, CME funding, parental leave, physician advisors and more! Visit www.doctorsns.com for more information Qualifications all applicants must be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Nova Scotia (CPSNS) all family physicians must have membership with the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CFPC) all specialists must be eligible for certification with the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (RCPSC) membership with the Canadian Medical Protective Association (CMPA) all applicants must have a current PALS Certification all applicants must have a current ATLS Certification current ACLS Certification is a preferred qualification Additional Information Shelburne On the province’s South Shore, the Town of Shelburne offers unique experiences that are rich in culture and adventure, with places to relax and unwind in a surrounding of historic treasures, wilderness and beauty. Shelburne's blend of history, coastal beauty, and welcoming community make it a charming home for those seeking a tranquil and culturally rich coastal lifestyle in Nova Scotia. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ru9GOnpR7iE https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AMvXs9NZa7I https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uph18O-__ag Practicing in Nova Scotia Physicians in Nova Scotia provide fulfilling patient care which embraces family life, professional development and community involvement. That's what makes practicing medicine in Nova Scotia unique. Physicians are increasingly attracted to practices that offer team-based care to their patients and allow them to consult with their peers. The size and scale of Nova Scotia allows for better connections across the health care system. Your practice of medicine and your life is richer here. Nova Scotia is more than medicine. Building a Diverse Workforce The Physician Recruitment Team at Nova Scotia Health lives and works in Mi’kma’ki, the unceded and ancestral territory of the Mi’kmaq people. We are dedicated to equity, diversity, inclusion, and truth and reconciliation, and we are working to support medical communities that are reflective of and responsive to the diverse populations they serve in Nova Scotia. We welcome physicians from diverse backgrounds and experiences to join us in building healthier, more equitable communities across the province.

jobs.title: EOI – Emergency Medicine Lead – Shelburne
jobs.full_description_text: Company Description Nova Scotia Health is the largest provider of health services in Nova Scotia, with some specialized services also offered to clients throughout Atlantic Canada. We’re on a mission to achieve excellence in health, healing, and learning through working together, which is reflected in the hospitals, health centers, and community-based programs we operate across the province. Our passionate team of professionals provides a variety of high-quality inpatient and outpatient services including academic, tertiary, and quaternary care, as well as continuing care, primary health care, public health, and mental health and addictions. Join a diverse team of innovators, collaborators, and creative thinkers today. Job Description Nova Scotia Health (NSH) is seeking expressions of interest for the role of Site Specialty Lead for the Emergency Department at Roseway Hospital in the Western Zone The Emergency Medicine Lead endeavors to ensure that a high standard of patient care is maintained by the medical staff of Emergency, in accordance with the law, the Bylaws, the Rules and Regulations, licensing and accreditation standards and the standards of academic institutions (where applicable). RESPONSIBILITIES The Western Zone, Roseway Hospital, Emergency Medicine Lead: Will ensure that the mission, vision and values of the NSHA are embodied in their leadership and will participate in the development and implementation of the NSHA corporate strategic plan and its implementation. Will develop regular and collaborative relationships with Zone Department Heads, other Medical Site Leads, Deputy/Division/Service Heads, and Health Service Directors and will act as a resource to the appropriate VP of Integrated Health Service. Will participate in the Roseway Hospital Clinical Affairs, M & M reviews, Roseway Hospital ED Ops committees, and/or other facility-based committees as required. Will develop and foster collaborative relationships with the Emergency Health Service Manager, Health Services Director and Hants Medical Site Lead for the safe and efficient functioning of the Department. Will ensure proper Emergency Medicine standards of care, as well as active participation in WZESC. The Western Zone, Roseway Hospital, Emergency Medicine Lead: Receives and acts, through appropriate channels, on all reports from the medical staff or administration with respect to situations which may adversely affect patient care in or at the hospital. Ensures that the Physician ED Staff are kept informed of changes in hospital policy, objectives, and regulation. Will participate in policy development as it pertains to their individual facility. Is responsible to work collaboratively with the Zone Department Heads to ensure the integration of departmental activities within their community/facility. Is responsible to work collaboratively with the Zone Department Heads in planning for the physician human resource needs unique to their community/facility. This will include the development of recruitment, selection, orientation and retention strategies. Is responsible to actively participate in the Zone process for credentialing and privileging of ED physician staff members at their facility. Is responsible for implementing and maintaining appropriate measures to ensure that the quality of services offered by all members of the ED Physician Staff is evaluated on a regular basis and those corrective actions are taken when problems are identified. Is responsible for monitoring practices of members of the Physician ED Staff to ensure compliance with the NSHA Medical Staff Bylaws, the Rules & Regulations and policies established by the Zone MAC and the Board. Will make every effort to ensure that there is appropriate physician coverage for the daily operations of the Roseway Hospital Emergency Department. Working through and with Zonal Department Heads, oversees the medical care given to patients presenting to the ED for care. Will report to the Medical Site Lead at Roseway Hospital for day-to-day issues regarding clinical/patient problems, communication breakdown and any problems that affect the ED and Roseway Hospital. Will report to the Zonal Department Head of ED regarding quality, WZESC, and overall ED zone planning. Qualifications The Western Zone, Roseway Hospital, Emergency Medicine Lead must be an active member of a clinical department within the NSHA. Must be a credentialed physician with privileges at a site within the NSHA. Will undergo an annual performance review, and will do a performance appraisal on physicians within their department. Will maintain their clinical activity as well as their commitment to support teaching and research. Additional Information Community Details Conveniently located an hour from the Yarmouth Ferry and just two hours from Halifax , on Nova Scotia’s beautiful South Shore, the Town of Shelburne is a unique, rural community with a lot to experience. Our Municipality offers lighthouses , rugged coastlines, white sand beaches, fishing villages with colourful boats and neighbourly people. You can cycle our rural roads, walk our trails, go fishing in our lakes and rivers, paddle in the ocean or sit back and bird watch. For the golfer, we have a beautiful 18 hole golf course in Clyde River and in Birchtown, you can take a guided tour of the new Black Loyalist Heritage Centre and Historical Site, the first freed black settlement in North America. Each day in Sandy Point when the tide is low, you can walk to the lighthouse and in the summer, stop at their Community Centre to enjoy refreshments and ice cream. The Municipality boasts a rich maritime history and the third best natural harbour in the world. We invite you to come and give yourself a rest from life’s hustle and bustle, where you can enjoy everything we have to offer at your own pace. We value a quality of life that is second to none and we want to share this with you. Physicians in Nova Scotia provide fulfilling patient care which embraces family life, professional development and community involvement. That's what makes practicing medicine in Nova Scotia unique. Physicians are increasingly attracted to practices that offer team-based care to their patients and allow them to consult with their peers. The size and scale of Nova Scotia allows for better connections across the health care system. Your practice of medicine and your life is richer here. Nova Scotia is more than medicine. Nova Scotia Health Authority (NSHA) is committed to being a workforce that is free of discrimination, values diversity and is representative, at all job levels, of the people we serve. Our priority groups are Aboriginal People, African Nova Scotians, Persons with Disabilities and Recent Immigrants. Members of these groups are welcome to apply and self-identify if they wish to be considered under our Employment Equity policy.

That's what makes practicing medicine in Nova Scotia unique. Physicians are increasingly attracted to practices that offer team-based care to their patients and allow them to consult with their peers. The size and scale of Nova Scotia allows for better connections across the health care system. Your practice of medicine and your life is richer here. Nova Scotia is more than medicine.  Building a Diverse Workforce The Physician Recruitment Team at Nova Scotia Health lives and works in Mi’kma’ki, the unceded and ancestral territory of the Mi’kmaq people. We are dedicated to equity, diversity, inclusion, and truth and reconciliation, and we are working to support medical communities that are reflective of and responsive to the diverse populations they serve in Nova Scotia. We welcome physicians from diverse backgrounds and experiences to join us in building healthier, more equitable communities across the province.
structured_sections.Company Description: Nova Scotia Health is the largest provider of health services in Nova Scotia, with some specialized services also offered to clients throughout Atlantic Canada. We’re on a mission to achieve excellence in health, healing, and learning through working together, which is reflected in the hospitals, health centers, and community-based programs we operate across the province. Our passionate team of professionals provides a variety of high-quality inpatient and outpatient services including academic, tertiary, and quaternary care, as well as continuing care, primary health care, public health, and mental health and addictions. Join a diverse team of innovators, collaborators, and creative thinkers today.
structured_sections.Job Description: Roseway Hospital (RH) is seeking a full-time emergency physician who, if desired, can also provide office based comprehensive primary care and inpatient care. RH provides health care services to approximately 15,000 Shelburne County residents including inpatient, outpatient, and satellite care as well as primary, ambulatory, and emergency care. Located in Shelburne, RH has 19 inpatient beds and works closely with other health care facilities in Yarmouth, Kentville, Liverpool, Bridgewater, and Halifax. Shelburne County also has a collaborative practice clinic that provides the opportunity to mentor medical residents enrolled in the Dalhousie Family Medicine Program.
structured_sections.Responsibilities: examine patients and take their histories order diagnostic tests and laboratory procedures advise patients on health care, health promotion, and disease prevention consult and refer to other medical practitioners act as a patient advocate prescribe and administer medications and treatments, inoculations and vaccinations Expected Hours full-time
structured_sections.Qualifications: all applicants must be eligible for licensure with the  College of Physicians and Surgeons of Nova Scotia  (CPSNS) all family physicians must be eligible for certification with the  College of Family Physicians of Canada  (CFPC) membership with the  Canadian Medical Protective Association  (CMPA) Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support  (ACLS) Basic Cardiac Life Support (BCLS) Care of the Critically Ill Surgical Patient  (CCrISP) Neonatal Resuscitation Program  (NRP) Pediatric Advanced Life Support  (PALS) College of Family Physicians of Canada  ER certification  considered an asset
structured_sections.Community Details: Conveniently located an hour from Yarmouth and just two hours from  Halifax , on Nova Scotia’s beautiful South Shore, the  Town of Shelburne  is a unique, rural community with a lot to experience. Our Municipality offers lighthouses, rugged coastlines, white sand beaches, fishing villages with colourful boats and neighbourly people. You can cycle our rural roads, walk our trails, go fishing in our lakes and rivers, paddle in the ocean or sit back and bird watch. For the golfer, we have a beautiful 18 hole golf course in Clyde River and in Birchtown, you can take a guided tour of the new Black Loyalist Heritage Centre and Historical Site, the first freed black settlement in North America. Each day in  Sandy Point  when the tide is low, you can walk to the lighthouse and in the summer, stop at their Community Centre to enjoy refreshments and ice cream.  The Municipality boasts a rich maritime history and the third best natural harbour in the world. We invite you to come and give yourself a rest from life’s hustle and bustle, where you can enjoy everything we have to offer at your own pace. We value a quality of life that is second to none and we want to share this with you.   Click here to learn more

jobs.title: EOI – Emergency Medicine Lead – Roseway Hospital
jobs.full_description_text: Company Description About this opportunity EOI – Emergency Medicine Lead – Roseway Hospital Compensation: In accordance with leadership remuneration framework Location: Western Zone, Roseway Hospital Status: Permanent Nova Scotia Health (NSH) is seeking expressions of interest for the role of Site Specialty Lead for the Emergency Department at Roseway Hospital in the Western Zone The Emergency Medicine Lead endeavors to ensure that a high standard of patient care is maintained by the medical staff of Emergency, in accordance with the law, the Bylaws, the Rules and Regulations, licensing and accreditation standards and the standards of academic institutions (where applicable). Job Description ACCOUNTABILITY Works in collaboration with Medical Lead and Zone Emergency Medicine Department Head. RESPONSIBILITIES The Western Zone, Roseway Hospital, Emergency Medicine Lead: Will ensure that the mission, vision and values of the NSHA are embodied in their leadership and will participate in the development and implementation of the NSHA corporate strategic plan and its implementation. Will develop regular and collaborative relationships with Zone Department Heads, other Medical Site Leads, Deputy/Division/Service Heads, and Health Service Directors and will act as a resource to the appropriate VP of Integrated Health Service. Will participate in the Roseway Hospital Clinical Affairs, M & M reviews, Roseway Hospital ED Ops committees, and/or other facility-based committees as required. Will develop and foster collaborative relationships with the Emergency Health Service Manager, Health Services Director and Hants Medical Site Lead for the safe and efficient functioning of the Department. Will ensure proper Emergency Medicine standards of care, as well as active participation in WZESC. The Western Zone, Roseway Hospital, Emergency Medicine Lead: Receives and acts, through appropriate channels, on all reports from the medical staff or administration with respect to situations which may adversely affect patient care in or at the hospital. Ensures that the Physician ED Staff are kept informed of changes in hospital policy, objectives, and regulation. Will participate in policy development as it pertains to their individual facility. Is responsible to work collaboratively with the Zone Department Heads to ensure the integration of departmental activities within their community/facility. Is responsible to work collaboratively with the Zone Department Heads in planning for the physician human resource needs unique to their community/facility. This will include the development of recruitment, selection, orientation and retention strategies. Is responsible to actively participate in the Zone process for credentialing and privileging of ED physician staff members at their facility. Is responsible for implementing and maintaining appropriate measures to ensure that the quality of services offered by all members of the ED Physician Staff is evaluated on a regular basis and those corrective actions are taken when problems are identified. Is responsible for monitoring practices of members of the Physician ED Staff to ensure compliance with the NSHA Medical Staff Bylaws, the Rules & Regulations and policies established by the Zone MAC and the Board. Will make every effort to ensure that there is appropriate physician coverage for the daily operations of the Roseway Hospital Emergency Department. Working through and with Zonal Department Heads, oversees the medical care given to patients presenting to the ED for care. Will report to the Medical Site Lead at Roseway Hospital for day-to-day issues regarding clinical/patient problems, communication breakdown and any problems that affect the ED and Roseway Hospital. Will report to the Zonal Department Head of ED regarding quality, WZESC, and overall ED zone planning. Qualifications The Western Zone, Roseway Hospital, Emergency Medicine Lead must be an active member of a clinical department within the NSHA. Must be a credentialed physician with privileges at a site within the NSHA. Will undergo an annual performance review, and will do a performance appraisal on physicians within their department. Will maintain their clinical activity as well as their commitment to support teaching and research. Additional Information Community Details Conveniently located an hour from the Yarmouth Ferry and just two hours from Halifax , on Nova Scotia’s beautiful South Shore, the Town of Shelburne is a unique, rural community with a lot to experience. Our Municipality offers lighthouses , rugged coastlines, white sand beaches, fishing villages with colourful boats and neighbourly people. You can cycle our rural roads, walk our trails, go fishing in our lakes and rivers, paddle in the ocean or sit back and bird watch. For the golfer, we have a beautiful 18 hole golf course in Clyde River and in Birchtown, you can take a guided tour of the new Black Loyalist Heritage Centre and Historical Site, the first freed black settlement in North America. Each day in Sandy Point when the tide is low, you can walk to the lighthouse and in the summer, stop at their Community Centre to enjoy refreshments and ice cream. The Municipality boasts a rich maritime history and the third best natural harbour in the world. We invite you to come and give yourself a rest from life’s hustle and bustle, where you can enjoy everything we have to offer at your own pace. We value a quality of life that is second to none and we want to share this with you. Physicians in Nova Scotia provide fulfilling patient care which embraces family life, professional development and community involvement. That's what makes practicing medicine in Nova Scotia unique. Physicians are increasingly attracted to practices that offer team-based care to their patients and allow them to consult with their peers. The size and scale of Nova Scotia allows for better connections across the health care system. Your practice of medicine and your life is richer here. Nova Scotia is more than medicine. Nova Scotia Health Authority (NSHA) is committed to being a workforce that is free of discrimination, values diversity and is representative, at all job levels, of the people we serve. Our priority groups are Aboriginal People, African Nova Scotians, Persons with Disabilities and Recent Immigrants. Members of these groups are welcome to apply and self-identify if they wish to be considered under our Employment Equity policy.

jobs.title: Physician
jobs.full_description_text: About Meaford Medical Centre Meaford Medical Centre is a newly established, state-of-the-art integrated healthcare facility opening on September 1, 2026 , at 125 Eliza Street, Meaford, Ontario . Our vision is to transform community healthcare by delivering comprehensive medical services through an innovative "All-Under-One-Roof" model. The Centre will bring together primary care, pharmacy, diagnostic blood collection, physiotherapy, chiropractic care, dentistry, and optometry in one convenient location, creating a seamless patient experience while improving access to quality healthcare for Meaford and the surrounding communities. We are seeking compassionate, patient-focused Family Physicians and General Practitioners who are interested in joining a collaborative multidisciplinary healthcare team. Opportunities are available on a full-time, part-time, or locum basis , offering flexibility to suit a variety of practice preferences. We are proud to partner with the Municipality of Meaford, which is offering a $30,000 recruitment incentive to qualifying physicians joining our team—a testament to our community’s commitment to investing in high-quality, accessible local healthcare. Position Summary The successful physician will provide comprehensive primary healthcare services within our high-volume walk-in clinic while collaborating with an experienced multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals. Physicians will practice in a modern clinical environment equipped with advanced technology, electronic medical records (EMR), and integrated on-site healthcare services designed to improve efficiency and patient outcomes. Key Responsibilities Assess, diagnose, and manage acute and chronic medical conditions. Provide comprehensive primary healthcare services to patients of all ages. Order, interpret, and review laboratory and diagnostic investigations. Prescribe medications and develop evidence-based treatment plans. Maintain accurate and timely electronic medical records (EMR). Refer patients to specialists and allied healthcare professionals when clinically appropriate. Collaborate closely with pharmacists, physiotherapists, chiropractors, dentists, optometrists, and other healthcare providers to deliver coordinated patient care. Promote preventative healthcare through patient education and health promotion initiatives. Ensure compliance with CPSO standards, OHIP billing requirements, and evidence-based clinical practice. Participate in continuous quality improvement initiatives that enhance patient safety and clinical excellence. Qualifications Applicants should possess: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or equivalent medical degree. Independent registration or eligibility for registration with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario (CPSO) Certification with the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CCFP) is considered an asset. Membership or eligibility for membership with the Canadian Medical Protective Association (CMPA) . Strong clinical judgment and patient-centred communication skills. Commitment to collaborative, multidisciplinary healthcare. New graduates, experienced physicians, and internationally trained physicians who are eligible to practice in Ontario are encouraged to apply. What We Offer Brand-new, fully renovated, modern medical facility. Flexible scheduling with Full-Time, Part-Time, and Locum opportunities. Competitive physician compensation. Professional administrative support for scheduling and billing. Modern Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system. Integrated healthcare environment with on-site pharmacy, diagnostic blood collection, physiotherapy, chiropractic care, dentistry, and optometry. Collaborative multidisciplinary team environment. Opportunity to build a long-term practice in a rapidly growing healthcare centre. Supportive leadership focused on physician success and work-life balance. Compensation Competitive compensation package available. Compensation options may include: Fee-for-Service Split Flexible arrangements based on physician preference and experience Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process. Schedule Flexible scheduling available, including: Full-Time Part-Time Locum Coverage Weekday Clinics Evening Clinics (where applicable) Weekend Clinics (optional) Start Date Se ptember 1, 2026 Earlier on boarding may be available to support orientation and clinic preparation.

jobs.title: Family Physician with Obstetrical Skills
jobs.full_description_text: Family Physician with Obstetrical Skills Guelph General Hospital is seeking a skilled Family Physician with Obstetrical Skills to join our outstanding team in beautiful Guelph, Ontario. As a key member of our medical team, you will collaborate with a dedicated group of experienced physicians to provide exceptional care to our community. About Guelph General Hospital: Guelph General Hospital (GGH) is a dynamic, comprehensive acute care facility providing a full range of services to over 200,000 residents of Guelph and Wellington County. Our services include 24-hour emergency coverage, advanced technology and diagnostic support, and a variety of specialty programs. GGH is the Regional provider for general vascular surgery and a designated Provincial Centre of Excellence for Bariatric Surgery. Why Guelph, Ontario? Located in Southwestern Ontario, Guelph is known for its rich architectural heritage, vibrant culture and a strong sense of community. Ranked as one of the top 10 best cities to live in Canada, Guelph offers a high quality of life, excellent education, low crime rates, and a wide range of recreational opportunities. With its thriving arts scene, beautiful parks, and growing economy, Guelph is an attractive destination for professionals and families alike. Family Physician Opportunities Guelph General Hospital (GGH) is recruiting for two Family Physicians with Obstetrical Skills to join our growing group of Family Physicians with Obstetrical Skill (FP-OB) working on our Family Birthing Unit. GGH has approximately 1,700 deliveries a year on our integrated antepartum/L&D/postpartum unit with an adjacent level 2a nursery. The FP-OB group is supported in practicing the fullness of their scope by an amazing group of OBs and Paediatricians. Remuneration is fee for service with an on-call stipend. Our Family Physicians with Obstetrical Skill group provides prenatal care and attendance at deliveries in a group clinic/hard call model. They support the smooth running of the FBU through the provision of C-Section assists as well as participation in the group providing care to well newborns. The Guelph Family Health Team is willing to support and work with candidates interested in exploring community practice opportunities. Both permanent members of the group or long-term (i.e. minimum 3 month) locums are welcome. Please send your expression of interest and up-to-date curriculum vitae to the attention of: Dr. Kate Miller, Division Head of Family Practice Obstetrical Care at Guelph General Hospital. PSrecruitment@gghorg.ca .

jobs.title: Dermatologist – Guelph – 80/20 FFS Split, Procedure Room, Flexible Days
jobs.full_description_text: Verismo Health Inc. is seeking a skilled and dedicated Dermatologist to join our team at East Guelph Medical Clinic, Unit A5 - 320 Eastview Road, Guelph, Ontario. Guelph and Wellington County are materially underserved for dermatology. Local family physicians routinely refer patients out of the region to Kitchener-Waterloo, Hamilton and the GTA, and wait times for routine consultation run long. The referral demand is already here; today it is simply leaving the catchment. In a fully furnished, well-equipped environment with a dedicated procedure room, you will have the resources you need to provide exceptional dermatologic care to patients of all ages in Guelph and the surrounding Wellington County community. This is a turnkey arrangement - space, equipment, EMR, reception, booking, referral intake and billing are all in place - and it is available from one day per week. RESPONSIBILITIES Provide comprehensive dermatologic consultation and management for patients of all ages, including diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic skin, hair and nail conditions. Perform thorough patient assessments, including history-taking, full skin examination and dermoscopy. Diagnose and manage inflammatory skin disease, including psoriasis, eczema, acne and rosacea. Conduct skin cancer surveillance and perform in-office surgical dermatology, including shave and punch biopsies, excisions, cryotherapy and intralesional injection. Order and interpret diagnostic tests, including histopathology, patch testing and laboratory work. Develop and implement individualized treatment plans, including systemic and biologic therapy where indicated. Provide timely consultation reports back to referring family physicians. Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records for all patients. Collaborate with the clinic's medical, nursing and administrative staff to ensure efficient, patient-centred care. QUALIFICATIONS Medical degree (MD or DO) from an accredited institution. Valid medical license in the province of Ontario (CPSO), or eligibility for independent practice registration. Certification in Dermatology (FRCPC or equivalent), or eligibility for certification. CMPA coverage. Excellent clinical judgment and diagnostic skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work well in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. BENEFITS 80/20 fee-for-service split - physician-friendly and transparent. jobs.title: Full Time Vascular Surgery Locum Position
jobs.full_description_text: Guelph General Hospital Level 2 Regional Vascular Program is seeking an RCPSC-certified Vascular Surgeon to join our growing team in Guelph, Ontario. This is a one year locum position to fill an absence starting in 2026. Start time is flexible depending on candidate availability. As a key member of our medical team, you will collaborate with a dedicated group of experienced Vascular Surgeons to provide regional care to the city and surrounding communities. jobs.title: General Internal Medicine Physician
jobs.full_description_text: General Internal Medicine Physician GIM Clinic • Guelph, Ontario • Outpatient consulting practice • No on-call The opportunity GIM Clinic is recruiting a General Internal Medicine specialist to join our consultant group in a new, purpose-built outpatient space in the south end of Guelph. Six general internists from Guelph General Hospital already practise with us. This is a community-based ambulatory opportunity that is entirely separate from hospital work. There is no on-call, no inpatient service, and no after-hours obligation attached to this position. You practise the days you choose to practise. What you would do Our core service is the Acute Internal Medicine Service (AIMS) — the pathway through which family physicians in Guelph and Wellington County refer patients for timely internal medicine consultation. Every physician in the group contributes to AIMS. It is what sustains our referral base and keeps wait times short for the community. Beyond that, we actively support focused clinical interests. If there is an area of internal medicine you want to build a practice in, we will help you develop the referral stream, template the visits appropriately, and staff the clinic — on the understanding that you also see general internal medicine referrals through AIMS. Qualifications Certification in Internal Medicine by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (FRCPC), or recognition as a specialist in Internal Medicine by the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario A Certificate of Registration Authorizing Independent Practice with the CPSO, or eligibility to obtain one Current CMPA coverage Excellent bedside manner — unhurried, clear and respectful with patients, and communicative with referring family physicians. This matters to us as much as clinical ability does. A collegial approach to group practice Commitment Flexible. We are ideally looking for the equivalent of one week per month. That can be arranged as consecutive days, as individual days spread through the month, or as blocks of weeks across the year — whatever fits the rest of your practice. We are open to a smaller start with room to grow. What we offer No call and no inpatient obligations. Physician-owned and physician-led. GIM Clinic is directed by a practising internist, and clinical and operational decisions are made by physicians. This is not a pharmacy-affiliated practice — the pharmacy in the building is an independent tenant and a convenience for patients, nothing more. Flexible scheduling. You tell us the days; we build the clinic around them. Support for your professional interests. Room to develop a focused area of internal medicine alongside your general practice. A fully supported practice. Medical office assistant and nursing support, TELUS CHR EMR, and a sanctioned ambient AI scribe so your notes are finished when your day is. A competitive all-inclusive overhead split — one transparent figure covering space, staff, EMR and documentation tools, with no separate fees or hidden charges. Compensation is OHIP fee-for-service billings less that split; we are happy to go through the specifics at a first conversation. An established referral base from family physicians across Guelph and Wellington County. A new clinical space in south Guelph, in a building shared with a pharmacy, a radiology practice and an urgent care clinic — convenient for patients and for same-visit investigations. Collegial peers — a group of six general internists who also work at Guelph General Hospital. Informal enquiries are welcome. If you would like to see the space or speak with one of the physicians already practising here, we are glad to arrange it. GIM Clinic welcomes applications from all qualified physicians. Accommodations are available on request at any stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: General Obstetrician/Gynecologist
jobs.full_description_text: General Obstetrician/Gynecologist Job Opening at Guelph General Hospital Guelph General Hospital (GGH) is seeking a skilled General Obstetrician/Gynecologist to join our team. We are looking to fill a full-time position which would include community obstetric and gynecologic care, operating room time and participation in a 1 in 7 on-call rotation. We are proud of the supportive and collegial environment that is provided by our group of ob/gyns, midwives and family physicians who provide obstetrical care. GGH is classified as a Level 2A hospital, specializing in the care of mothers and babies from 34 weeks gestational age and above, delivering approximately 1800 babies annually. We are affiliated with both the Waterloo and Hamilton campuses of McMaster University Medical School which provides the opportunity to participate in teaching both medical students and residents. Applicants should be certified (or eligible for certification) with the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (RCPSC) and be licenced (or eligible for licensure) in the province of Ontario. About Guelph General Hospital: Guelph General Hospital (GGH) is a dynamic, comprehensive acute care facility providing a full range of services to over 200,000 residents of Guelph and Wellington County. Our services include 24-hour emergency coverage, advanced technology and diagnostic support, and a variety of specialty programs. Guelph General Hospital is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, gender, disability, or any other protected status. Why Guelph, Ontario? Located in Southwestern Ontario, Guelph is known for its rich architectural heritage, vibrant culture and a strong sense of community. The city was recently ranked by the Globe and Mail as the 7th most livable community in Ontario. Guelph offers a high quality of life, excellent education, low crime rates, and a wide range of recreational opportunities. With its thriving arts scene, beautiful parks, and growing economy, Guelph is an attractive destination for professionals and families alike. Guelph’s location conveniently allows for easy access to the GTA via transit (up 12 trains to Toronto-Union per day), or personal vehicle. It is 45min from Pearson International Airport and 25min from Region of Waterloo International Airport.

jobs.title: Dermatologist – Guelph – 80/20 FFS Split, Procedure Room, Flexible Days
jobs.full_description_text: Verismo Health Inc. is seeking a skilled and dedicated Dermatologist to join our team at East Guelph Medical Clinic, Unit A5 - 320 Eastview Road, Guelph, Ontario. Guelph and Wellington County are materially underserved for dermatology. Local family physicians routinely refer patients out of the region to Kitchener-Waterloo, Hamilton and the GTA, and wait times for routine consultation run long. The referral demand is already here; today it is simply leaving the catchment. In a fully furnished, well-equipped environment with a dedicated procedure room, you will have the resources you need to provide exceptional dermatologic care to patients of all ages in Guelph and the surrounding Wellington County community. This is a turnkey arrangement - space, equipment, EMR, reception, booking, referral intake and billing are all in place - and it is available from one day per week. RESPONSIBILITIES Provide comprehensive dermatologic consultation and management for patients of all ages, including diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic skin, hair and nail conditions. Perform thorough patient assessments, including history-taking, full skin examination and dermoscopy. Diagnose and manage inflammatory skin disease, including psoriasis, eczema, acne and rosacea. Conduct skin cancer surveillance and perform in-office surgical dermatology, including shave and punch biopsies, excisions, cryotherapy and intralesional injection. Order and interpret diagnostic tests, including histopathology, patch testing and laboratory work. Develop and implement individualized treatment plans, including systemic and biologic therapy where indicated. Provide timely consultation reports back to referring family physicians. Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records for all patients. Collaborate with the clinic's medical, nursing and administrative staff to ensure efficient, patient-centred care. QUALIFICATIONS Medical degree (MD or DO) from an accredited institution. Valid medical license in the province of Ontario (CPSO), or eligibility for independent practice registration. Certification in Dermatology (FRCPC or equivalent), or eligibility for certification. CMPA coverage. Excellent clinical judgment and diagnostic skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work well in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. BENEFITS 80/20 fee-for-service split - physician-friendly and transparent. Flexible work schedule, including the option to choose days that suit your availability, from one day per week. Dedicated procedure room equipped for surgical dermatology. Supportive and experienced medical, nursing and administrative team. Access to well-equipped, fully furnished medical facilities. Established referral flow from surrounding family practices, so your schedule fills from day one. No capital outlay, no lease, no staffing costs, no EMR licence fees and no buy-in. Opportunities for professional growth and development. Front desk and admin support. Backend operational support. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION The clinic is conveniently located in Guelph's east end at Unit A5 - 320 Eastview Road, with ample parking for both staff and patients and direct Highway 401 access. A fully furnished, well-equipped clinic with a dedicated procedure room. Private-pay and cosmetic services can be accommodated; terms discussed on a case-by-case basis. We offer flexible holiday scheduling to ensure a healthy work-life balance. New graduates, established physicians seeking an additional satellite day, and locums are all welcome to apply. If you are a dedicated dermatologist looking for a fulfilling opportunity to make a positive impact on the health and well-being of patients in a supportive and well-equipped environment, we encourage you to apply. Verismo Health Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.title: Gynaecologist – Guelph – 80/20 FFS Split, Procedure Room, Flexible Days
jobs.full_description_text: Verismo Health Inc. is seeking a skilled and dedicated Gynaecologist to join our team at East Guelph Medical Clinic, Unit A5 - 320 Eastview Road, Guelph, Ontario. Women in Guelph and Wellington County wait a long time for gynaecologic consultation, and a substantial share of routine office gynaecology - abnormal uterine bleeding, contraception and IUD insertion, colposcopy, and menopause management - is currently referred out of region or absorbed by family physicians who would rather refer. In a fully furnished, well-equipped environment with a dedicated procedure room, you will have the resources you need to provide exceptional gynaecologic care to patients in Guelph and the surrounding Wellington County community. This is a turnkey arrangement - space, equipment, EMR, reception, booking, referral intake and billing are all in place - and it is available from one day per week. RESPONSIBILITIES Provide comprehensive office-based gynaecologic consultation and management for patients across the lifespan. Perform thorough patient assessments, including history-taking, pelvic examination and ultrasound interpretation. Diagnose and manage abnormal uterine bleeding, pelvic pain, endometriosis, fibroids and pelvic floor disorders. Provide contraceptive counselling and management, including insertion and removal of long-acting reversible contraception. Perform in-office procedures including endometrial biopsy, colposcopy, vulvar biopsy, and pessary fitting and management. Deliver menopause and perimenopause care, including hormone therapy management. Conduct cervical cancer screening follow-up and management of cervical dysplasia. Order and interpret diagnostic tests, including laboratory work, imaging and histopathology. Provide pre-operative consultation and coordinate surgical care as appropriate. Provide timely consultation reports back to referring family physicians. Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records for all patients. Collaborate with the clinic's medical, nursing and administrative staff to ensure efficient, patient-centred care. QUALIFICATIONS Medical degree (MD or DO) from an accredited institution. Valid medical license in the province of Ontario (CPSO), or eligibility for independent practice registration. Certification in Obstetrics and Gynaecology (FRCSC or equivalent), or eligibility for certification. CMPA coverage. Excellent clinical judgment and diagnostic skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work well in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. BENEFITS 80/20 fee-for-service split - physician-friendly and transparent. Flexible work schedule, including the option to choose days that suit your availability, from one day per week. Dedicated procedure room equipped for office gynaecology. Supportive and experienced medical, nursing and administrative team. Access to well-equipped, fully furnished medical facilities. Established referral flow from surrounding family practices - real waiting volume, with no practice to build from scratch. No capital outlay, no lease, no staffing costs, no EMR licence fees and no buy-in. Opportunities for professional growth and development. Front desk and admin support. Backend operational support. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION The clinic is conveniently located in Guelph's east end at Unit A5 - 320 Eastview Road, with ample parking for both staff and patients and direct Highway 401 access. A fully furnished, well-equipped clinic with a dedicated procedure room. This is an office-based gynaecology role; hospital and operating room arrangements are the physician's own. We are glad to discuss how an office practice here can complement existing hospital privileges. We offer flexible holiday scheduling to ensure a healthy work-life balance. New graduates, established physicians seeking additional office days, and locums are all welcome to apply. If you are a dedicated gynaecologist looking for a fulfilling opportunity to make a positive impact on the health and well-being of patients in a supportive and well-equipped environment, we encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Staff Gynaecologist
jobs.full_description_text: We are seeking an Ontario based Staff Gynecologist to join our family medicine clinic. You will work alongside our primary care team to provide on-site gynecological care. This role offers an immediate internal patient referral stream while helping reduce specialist wait times in our community. It is an ideal fit for a physician currently living and registered to practice in Ontario. Responsibilities Patient Assessment and Diagnosis Perform gynaecological evaluations and diagnostic assessments for clinic patients. Formulate clinical diagnoses based on medical history and patient examinations. Order or perform relevant diagnostic tests, imaging, or medical investigations to support patient care. Treatment Planning and Care Management Design, implement, and monitor individualized gynecological treatment plans. Provide medical oversight, ongoing medication management, and specialized interventions. Deliver targeted clinical procedures or refer patients to appropriate specialized programs. Shared Care and Support Complete clinical documentation and required medical reports in a timely manner. jobs.title: Psychiatrist – Guelph – 80/20 FFS Split, In-Person/Virtual, Flexible Days
jobs.full_description_text: Verismo Health Inc. is seeking a skilled and dedicated Psychiatrist to join our team at East Guelph Medical Clinic, Unit A5 - 320 Eastview Road, Guelph, Ontario. Access to psychiatry is one of the sharpest gaps in the Guelph-Wellington catchment. Family physicians in the area have limited options for timely adult psychiatric consultation, and patients frequently wait months or travel out of region for care. In a fully furnished, well-equipped environment, you will have the resources you need to provide exceptional psychiatric care to patients in Guelph and the surrounding Wellington County community. This is a turnkey arrangement - space, EMR, reception, scheduling, referral triage and billing are all in place - and it is available in-person, virtually or hybrid, from one day per week. RESPONSIBILITIES Provide comprehensive psychiatric consultation and assessment for patients referred by family physicians and community providers. Perform thorough psychiatric assessments, including history-taking, mental status examination and risk assessment. Diagnose and manage mood, anxiety, psychotic, attentional and substance use disorders. Initiate, adjust and monitor pharmacotherapy, including monitoring for adverse effects and drug interactions. Order and interpret relevant investigations, including laboratory work and therapeutic drug monitoring. Develop and implement individualized treatment and care plans, incorporating psychotherapeutic and psychosocial interventions as appropriate. Provide shared-care support and timely consultation reports to referring family physicians. Coordinate care and referrals with community mental health services and other specialties as needed. Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records for all patients. Collaborate with the clinic's medical, nursing and administrative staff to ensure efficient, patient-centred care. QUALIFICATIONS Medical degree (MD or DO) from an accredited institution. Valid medical license in the province of Ontario (CPSO), or eligibility for independent practice registration. Certification in Psychiatry (FRCPC or equivalent), or eligibility for certification. CMPA coverage. Excellent clinical judgment and diagnostic skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work well in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. BENEFITS 80/20 fee-for-service split - physician-friendly and transparent. Flexible work schedule, including the option to choose days that suit your availability, from one day per week. In-person, virtual or hybrid practice models supported. Private, quiet consultation rooms appropriate for psychiatric assessment. Supportive and experienced medical, nursing and administrative team. Access to well-equipped, fully furnished medical facilities. Established referral relationships with surrounding family practices and family health teams. Referral triage and intake handled by clinic staff. No lease, no staffing costs, no EMR licence fees and no buy-in. Opportunities for professional growth and development. Front desk and admin support. Backend operational support. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION The clinic is conveniently located in Guelph's east end at Unit A5 - 320 Eastview Road, with ample parking for both staff and patients and direct Highway 401 access. A fully furnished, well-equipped clinic. Scope is physician-defined - consultation-and-return, shared care with family physicians, or ongoing follow-up are all supported. General adult, geriatric, and child and adolescent psychiatry are all in demand locally; subspecialty focus can be accommodated in referral triage. We offer flexible holiday scheduling to ensure a healthy work-life balance. New graduates, established physicians seeking an additional day, and locums are all welcome to apply. If you are a dedicated psychiatrist looking for a fulfilling opportunity to make a positive impact on the mental health and well-being of patients in a supportive and well-equipped environment, we encourage you to apply. Verismo Health Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.title: Emergency Medicine Nocturnist - Kitchener-Waterloo
jobs.company: Waterloo Regional Health Network - Emergency Medicine
jobs.full_description_text: Welcome to Waterloo Regional Health Network, Midtown and Queen's Blvd. in Kitchener Ontario! A large and collegial group of CCFP(EM) + FRCPC EMs staffs these two busy community EDs. CERNER EMR seamlessly links data between both hospitals. Competitive AFA compensation + P4R Funding Support. Full service hospitals with essentially every service to back you up locally except trauma and neurosurgery, which are criticalled out. ED friendly policies ensure you get timely call backs from specialists! Strong Allied Health team in each ED to support timely patient disposition. We see a broad range of patients, including renal, oncology and trauma. We're a busy place and our 8 hour shifts usually fly by. We're teaching site for McMaster Med School and have lots of opportunities for teaching, SIM development, research and administrative roles if you're interested. KW is a great city and one of the fastest developing regions in the country. We have a high density of young professional families (2 universities, large IT sector, etc) and we find that younger doctors are particularly attracted to the area. Equitable schedule developed by Metric-Aid (preference-based scheduling system). Multiple "nocturnists" mean rest of us work fewer nights, half-night "casino" shifts also available. If you are a nocturnist, you are especially welcome! Looking for locum, PT or FT (or locum leading to permanent placement). CCFP with significant experience (e.g. SEME program at U of T), CCFP(EM), FRCPC welcome contact Dr Clark Eeuwes in confidence kwemarecruiting@gmail.com

jobs.title: Level III Echocardiographer (Cardiologist)
jobs.full_description_text: Level llI Echocardiographer (Cardiologist) at WRHN (Waterloo Regional Health Network) Waterloo Regional Health Network is excited to invite applications for a Cardiologist with level Ill echocardiography training. If you have completed at least a one-year fellowship in adult echocardiography and have a strong foundation in general cardiology, we would like to hear from you! Why Join Us? Diverse Role: Engage in all aspects of echocardiography, including diagnostic TTE, TEE, and stress echo (exercise, bike, and dobutamine). Specialization Opportunities: Focus in areas such as interventional echocardiography and valvular heart disease. Professional Development: Benefit from an environment that values interventional echocardiography, multimodality imaging, quality improvement, and research. Teaching Opportunities: Contribute to medical education at our affiliated teaching site for the Waterloo Campus of McMaster's medical school. jobs.title: Pediatrician Opportunity (FT/PT) - Milton
jobs.full_description_text: MedCare Clinics @ Walmart Milton – Pediatrician Opportunity MedCare Clinics is seeking a full-time or part-time Pediatrician to join our team at our Milton location. The Pediatrician may provide consultations for referred or walk-in pediatric patients, manage acute care visits, and support ongoing pediatric primary care needs within our busy multidisciplinary clinic. Why Join MedCare Clinics? Flexible Scheduling: Weekday, evening, and weekend shifts available. No on-call or mandatory hour requirements, supporting a strong work-life balance. Strong Internal Referral Base: Numerous family medicine providers practicing within the clinic ensure a consistent flow of pediatric referrals and immediate opportunities to establish a robust patient roster. Collaborative Team: Join a supportive network of Family Physicians, Pediatricians, NPs, nurses, MOAs, pharmacists, and clinical assistants/scribes who work cohesively to deliver high-quality care. Continuous Patient Care: Multiple physicians on site ensure seamless patient coverage during vacations or leave. Modern Facilities: On-site blood draw lab, triaged patient flow, sanitized pediatric-friendly equipment, and trained staff for immunizations, newborn screening support, and phlebotomy. Specialist Access: Established referral pathways to Allergy & Immunology, Cardiology, Dermatology, Psychiatry, and Diagnostic Imaging, with streamlined access for pediatric patients. High Patient Volume: Serve a diverse and rapidly growing pediatric population in a modern, high-traffic medical centre with free parking and convenient accessibility. Technology & Support: Accuro EMR and full administrative and billing support for efficient practice management. Compensation & Benefits Competitive, low income split with full transparency (no hidden overhead). Comprehensive Health & Dental benefits package for full-time physicians and their families. Opportunity to work across multiple MedCare Clinics locations. Additional Opportunities LMIA (NOC 31100 – Specialists in Clinical Medicine/Pediatrician) and pathway supervision available, if required. 📩 Apply Now Send your CV or inquiries to doctor@medcarehs.com 🌐 Learn more: www.medcareclinics.com We look forward to welcoming you to the MedCare team!

jobs.title: Academic Respirologist
jobs.full_description_text: ACADEMIC RESPIROLOGIST Department of Medicine, McMaster University The Department of Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences at McMaster University and Hamilton Health Sciences invite applications for an Academic Respirologist with a focus in the investigation and management of chronic cough and airways diseases. Preference will be given to candidates who will have completed two years of fellowship training in Respirology with further formal training in chronic cough with research experience being an asset to the position. The successful candidate will contribute to the Centre for Chronic Cough, holding specialized tertiary cough clinics as well as advanced airways clinics at McMaster University Health Centre and St Joseph’s Healthcare. They will also work closely with the Respirology Training Program to advance the educational profile of the program. This is a full-time faculty position for a period of three years (renewable). Academic rank will be commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications and experience. The successful candidate will be a full-time member of the Division of Respirology and will be expected to contribute to the academic mission of the Faculty and Division. The successful candidate should have appropriate fellowship training and will be expected to fully participate in all appropriate departmental and divisional educational activities. Applicants should be certified (or eligible for certification) by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada and must be licensed (or eligible for licensure) in the Province of Ontario. Please apply online to Job Opening 78739 via the McMaster Academic Careers website ( http://www.workingatmcmaster.ca/careers/ ) directing your application to: Sara Sellers Academic and Administrative Manager Expressions of interest should include: An up-to-date curriculum vitae and cover letter. A written description of training and research experience (two-page maximum). Applicants are encouraged to describe any impact that career interruptions have had on research, academic, and/or clinical scholarly productivity, if applicable. A brief statement describing any contributions made or planned in relation to advancing equity, diversity and inclusion, or inclusive excellence in teaching, research, or service within higher education, community-based, or other professional settings (two-page maximum). The names and addresses of three professional referees, including one current or recent supervisor. Letters of reference are not required and will not be reviewed at the application stage; letters of recommendation from referees will be requested at later stages of the search process. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply; however, Canadian citizens and permanent residents will be considered first for this position. To comply with the Government of Canada’s reporting requirements, the University is obliged to gather information about applicants’ status as either Permanent Residents of Canada or Canadian citizens. Applicants need not identify their country of origin or current citizenship; however, all applications must include one of the following statements: “Yes, I am a citizen or permanent resident of Canada” or “No, I am not a citizen or permanent resident of Canada” Pay Transparency Statement Compensation for Clinical Faculty is derived from multiple sources and varies based on clinical activity, speciality, and practice arrangements. Compensation may include a combination of university-based salary, stipends, hospital or partner organization funding, and earnings through clinical practice plans. How To Apply To apply for this job, please submit your application online. Employment Equity Statement McMaster University is located on the traditional territories of the Haudenosaunee and Mississauga Nations and within the lands protected by the “Dish With One Spoon” wampum agreement. The diversity of our workforce is at the core of our innovation and creativity and strengthens our research and teaching excellence. In keeping with its Statement on Building an Inclusive Community with a Shared Purpose, McMaster University strives to embody the values of respect, collaboration and diversity, and has a strong commitment to employment equity. The University seeks qualified candidates who share our commitment to equity and inclusion, who will contribute to the diversification of ideas and perspectives, and especially welcomes applications from indigenous (First Nations, Métis or Inuit) peoples, members of racialized communities, persons with disabilities, women, and persons who identify as 2SLGBTQ+. As part of McMaster’s commitment, all applicants are invited to complete a confidential Applicant Diversity Survey through the online application submission process. The Survey questionnaire requests voluntary self-identification in relation to equity-seeking groups that have historically faced and continue to face barriers in employment. Please refer to the Applicant Diversity Survey - Statement of Collection for additional information. Job applicants requiring accommodation to participate in the hiring process should contact: Human Resources Service Centre at 905-525-9140 ext. 222-HR (22247), or Faculty of Health Sciences HR Office at ext. 22207, or School of Graduate Studies at ext. 23679 to communicate accommodation needs. Vaccination Mandate - FHS This position is located in a host hospital or other healthcare site that has an active vaccination mandate in place. Successful applicants will need to comply with these and any other health and safety measures necessary as part of their appointment. AI Statement McMaster and its third-party partners may use AI tools to screen, assess, or select applicants during the hiring process. Please note that currently our recruitment platform does not use AI nor is it part of our current recommended recruitment process.

jobs.title: Family Practice & Walk-In Clinic Opportunity (Hamilton)
jobs.full_description_text: Family Practice & Walk-In Clinic | Full-Service Managed Practice We offer in-person family practice & walk-in visits as well as telemedicine services across multiple clinics throughout Ontario. This clinic is already established with existing patients and we are seeking to bring another supportive physician on board to serve the community. 3,000 sqft combined clinic and pharmacy space, 5 exam rooms, newly renovated and fully outfitted. Are you a Family Physician looking for an opportunity to build, grow, or expand your practice in Hamilton? Our Hamilton medical clinic is welcoming physicians to join a professional and supportive environment with a full-service managed practice model and optional lease opportunities. Whether you’re a new graduate looking to establish your first practice or an experienced physician with an existing local patient roster, we’d love to hear from you. Fluency in English, Arabic and Somali would certainly be an asset within this community. What We Offer Full-service managed practice Opportunity to lease clinical space with room to grow and expand (now and in the future) Established Hamilton clinic location New graduates welcome Physicians with established local rosters welcome Administrative, billing, and operational support, allowing you to focus on patient care A professional, collaborative, and supportive environment Resources and infrastructure to help physicians build and grow a successful practice Why Pharmabest? Pharmabest is a well-known company providing pharmacy and medical clinic support throughout the GTA and Golden Horseshoe. We’ve built our network from the ground up — one pharmacy and clinic at a time — creating healthcare environments that physicians and healthcare professionals can rely on. At Pharmabest Medical Clinics, we believe physicians should have the support and infrastructure they need to focus on what matters most — providing excellent patient care. Whether you’re starting from the ground up, building a new patient roster, or bringing an established practice to Hamilton, our experienced team is here to support you. Join a network where you’ll have the support, resources, and team behind you to build a practice you can be proud of — and be happy to be a part of. If you’re ready to build, grow, or relocate your practice in Hamilton, we want to hear from you. To Apply: Please send your expression of interest and CV to: pharmabestmedicalclinics@gmail.com Pharmabest Medical Clinics — Build your practice. Focus on your patients. We’ll support the rest.

jobs.title: Academic Dermatologist
jobs.full_description_text: ACADEMIC DERMATOLOGIST Department of Medicine, McMaster University The Department of Medicine within the Faculty of Health Sciences at McMaster University, in partnership with Hamilton Health Sciences invites applications for an Academic Dermatologist. The successful candidate is expected to fully participate in all appropriate departmental and divisional educational activities. Additionally, the applicant should demonstrate strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, along with the drive to enhance both clinical and academic productivity within the Dermatology Division. A dedication to education at all levels is critical, and interest in formal educational roles would be beneficial. This is a full-time faculty position for a period of three years (renewable). Academic rank will be commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications and experience. The successful candidate will play an active role in the Division of Dermatology's clinical, educational, and academic activities. This includes delivering high-quality specialized dermatologic care, teaching and mentoring learners at all levels, and participating in research and scholarly initiatives. Applicants should be certified or eligible for certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada and must be licensed or eligible for licensure in the Province of Ontario. Please apply online to Job Opening 78582 via the McMaster Academic Careers website ( http://www.workingatmcmaster.ca/careers/ ) directing your application to: Sara Sellers Academic & Administrative Manager Expressions of interest should include: An up-to-date curriculum vitae and cover letter. A written description of training and research experience (two-page maximum). Applicants are encouraged to describe any impact that career interruptions have had on research, academic, and/or clinical scholarly productivity, if applicable. A brief statement describing any contributions made or planned in relation to advancing equity, diversity and inclusion, or inclusive excellence in teaching, research, or service within higher education, community-based, or other professional settings (two-page maximum). The names and addresses of three professional referees, including one current or recent supervisor. Letters of reference are not required and will not be reviewed at the application stage; letters of recommendation from referees will be requested at later stages of the search process. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply; however, Canadian citizens and permanent residents will be considered first for this position. To comply with the Government of Canada’s reporting requirements, the University is obliged to gather information about applicants’ status as either Permanent Residents of Canada or Canadian citizens. Applicants need not identify their country of origin or current citizenship; however, all applications must include one of the following statements: “Yes, I am a citizen or permanent resident of Canada” or “No, I am not a citizen or permanent resident of Canada” Pay Transparency Statement Compensation for Clinical Faculty is derived from multiple sources and varies based on clinical activity, speciality, and practice arrangements. Compensation may include a combination of university-based salary, stipends, hospital or partner organization funding, and earnings through clinical practice plans. How To Apply To apply for this job, please submit your application online. Employment Equity Statement McMaster University is located on the traditional territories of the Haudenosaunee and Mississauga Nations and within the lands protected by the “Dish With One Spoon” wampum agreement. The diversity of our workforce is at the core of our innovation and creativity and strengthens our research and teaching excellence. In keeping with its Statement on Building an Inclusive Community with a Shared Purpose, McMaster University strives to embody the values of respect, collaboration and diversity, and has a strong commitment to employment equity. The University seeks qualified candidates who share our commitment to equity and inclusion, who will contribute to the diversification of ideas and perspectives, and especially welcomes applications from indigenous (First Nations, Métis or Inuit) peoples, members of racialized communities, persons with disabilities, women, and persons who identify as 2SLGBTQ+. As part of McMaster’s commitment, all applicants are invited to complete a confidential Applicant Diversity Survey through the online application submission process. The Survey questionnaire requests voluntary self-identification in relation to equity-seeking groups that have historically faced and continue to face barriers in employment. Please refer to the Applicant Diversity Survey - Statement of Collection for additional information. Job applicants requiring accommodation to participate in the hiring process should contact: Human Resources Service Centre at 905-525-9140 ext. 222-HR (22247), or Faculty of Health Sciences HR Office at ext. 22207, or School of Graduate Studies at ext. 23679 to communicate accommodation needs. Vaccination Mandate - FHS This position is located in a host hospital or other healthcare site that has an active vaccination mandate in place. Successful applicants will need to comply with these and any other health and safety measures necessary as part of their appointment. AI Statement McMaster and its third-party partners may use AI tools to screen, assess, or select applicants during the hiring process. Please note that currently our recruitment platform does not use AI nor is it part of our current recommended recruitment process.

jobs.title: Musculoskeletal (MSK) Radiologist - Academic and Community Imaging Opportunity
jobs.full_description_text: MUSCULOSKELETAL RADIOLOGIST Full-Time Academic & Clinical Opportunity Hamilton General Hospital | Tertiary MSK & Trauma Imaging | Hybrid reporting options Advance musculoskeletal imaging in a leading tertiary-care environment. Hamilton General Hospital, in partnership with the Department of Medical Imaging at McMaster University and Hamilton Health Sciences, is seeking a full-time academic Musculoskeletal Radiologist to join its established MSK imaging team. This opportunity combines subspecialty clinical practice, trauma and sports imaging, image-guided MSK intervention, teaching and academic involvement within a collaborative multidisciplinary environment. Why Join the MSK Team · Leading tertiary-care setting - Hamilton General Hospital is a Level 1 orthopedic trauma regional centre · Diverse MSK practice - sports injury, trauma, pain management, rehabilitation, soft tissue, bone and joint pathology · Hybrid reporting options with a combination of on-site and remote reporting opportunities · Collaborative practice with orthopedic surgery, plastic surgery, neurology, family medicine and physiatry · Academic appointment through McMaster University with teaching, mentorship and research opportunities · Established group of subspecialty-trained radiologists across tertiary and community imaging practice · Flexible percentage FTE status may be available for interested applicants About the Practice The MSK Radiology Division at Hamilton General Hospital supports a broad regional population and works closely with multidisciplinary clinical teams to provide timely, evidence-based care. The practice spans primary through tertiary musculoskeletal imaging, with particular strength in orthopedic trauma and sports-related pathology. The Opportunity · Clinical work across musculoskeletal imaging modalities, including MSK ultrasound and BMD in community practice · MSK ultrasound and ultrasound-guided interventions, along with standard fluoroscopy/CT-guided MSK interventions · Participation in subspecialty, teaching and multidisciplinary trauma rounds · Some general and body radiology assignments and participation in the departmental body radiologist on-call schedule · Opportunity to contribute to teaching, mentorship, clinical scholarship and research Qualifications · Fellowship training in Musculoskeletal Imaging · Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada certification (or equivalent) · Licensed or eligible for licensure in Ontario and able to meet Hamilton Health Sciences credentialing requirements · Established experience in trauma and sports imaging, with strong diagnostic and interventional MSK skills Interested in Learning More? Qualified applicants are invited to submit their application materials or direct inquiries regarding this opportunity to: Dr. David Landry, Site Chief Department of Diagnostic Imaging, Hamilton General Hospital landryd@HHSC.CA

jobs.title: Academic Cardiologist - Expertise in Cardiac Imaging & Artificial Intelligence
jobs.full_description_text: Academic Cardiologist with Expertise in Cardiac Imaging & Artificial Intelligence Position Description The Department of Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences at McMaster University and St. Joseph’s Healthcare invite applications for an Academic Cardiologist with subspecialty expertise in multimodality cardiac imaging (cardiovascular CT and echocardiography) and an established record of accomplishment in artificial intelligence applied to cardiovascular imaging. Research, Innovation & AI Scholarship The successful candidate is expected to focus approximately 40% of their time on research developing, validating, and implementing AI algorithms and software for cardiovascular imaging. The candidate will have experience or formal training in AI and software development sufficient to lead an independent research program in this area. A key focus will be to develop and validate software tools (deep learning, statistical shape modelling, computational hemodynamics) for coronary CTA interpretation and TAVR CT procedural risk stratification. The candidate is expected to publish in peer-reviewed journals, present at major scientific meetings, pursue external grant funding, and engage McMaster’s AI / data-science ecosystem. Educational Responsibilities The candidate will supervise cardiology fellows and residents and provide clinical and research mentorship in cardiac CT and clinical AI/computational research methods. The candidate is expected to collaborate with the McMaster Biodesign group in education of students and supervision of student projects. The candidate will contribute to divisional academic half-day, structural-imaging rounds, and curriculum delivery for the Cardiovascular CT related fellowship programs. Clinical Responsibilities The candidate’s clinical time will be spent on cardiac CT, general cardiology outpatient and inpatient cardiology service, and echocardiography. The candidate will be responsible for Independently reporting cardiovascular CT studies, transthoracic echocardiograms and transesophageal echocardiograms. The candidate will participate in the on-call rotation to provide general cardiology coverage across outpatient clinics, CCU, and inpatient consult service. Required Qualifications MD or equivalent. Applicants should be certified (or eligible for certification) by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada and must be licensed (or eligible for licensure) in the Province of Ontario. Subspecialty fellowship training in Cardiovascular CT with focus on coronary imaging and TAVR planning studies. Demonstrated independent track record in clinical AI and software development for cardiovascular imaging or intervention, evidenced by deployed applications, patents, or peer-reviewed publications. This is a full-time faculty position for a period of three years (renewable). Academic rank will be commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications and experience. The successful candidate will be a full-time member of the Division of Cardiology and will be expected to contribute to the academic mission of the Faculty and Division. A written description of training and research experience (two-page maximum). Applicants are encouraged to describe any impact that career interruptions have had on research, academic, and/or clinical scholarly productivity, if applicable.
